active.title: Drop the dead Java 17 JVM options from the Spark Arrow path
active.description: On Temurin 17 with pyspark 3.5.8 the three Arrow tests pass without the extraJavaOptions netty reflection flag and java.nio --add-opens, because Spark's launcher adds the opens itself (the 0.8.1 PLAN M4 failure was Java 21). Design: amend the 0.8.1 AC2.8 contract that requires the options; delete them (and their comment) from the session builder in tests/fixtures/f2_spark_generator_specs_right.py; delete the netty sentence from rand_engine/cases/databricks.py.txt and docs/tutorials/databricks.md. Also: the databricks starter sets spark.sql.execution.arrow.pyspark.enabled on the shared session-wide test Spark session and nothing resets it, so the Spark tests depend on order (tests/test_9_cli.py runs the starter); the test that runs the starter restores the conf, or runs it on an isolated session.
active.provenance: operator ruling on the 0.8.1 intake report, 2026-10-20; Job 5 review 2026-10-20T134636Z (MEDIUM dead options, LOW Arrow conf left on)

active.title: Text generation performance follow-ups after the Arrow rewrite
active.description: (1) dates with time directives is only ~1.2x faster than 0.8.0 (7.71 s -> 6.28 s at 10M rows, measured in J3.T6) against ~25x for date-only, because each time field runs per-row digit loops; candidate: a two-digit pair table per field, as int_zfilled already does; 0.8.1 AC1.3 covered date-only only. (2) uuid4 in rand_engine/core/_np_core.py hex-encodes through bytes.hex().encode(), ~640 MB of temporaries at 10M rows; binascii.hexlify writes the hex bytes directly. (3) zero-row uuid4 and int_zfilled now return an empty Arrow column (0.8.0: empty float64, and a raise) and no test pins it; add the zero-size partition to their contract tests.
active.provenance: operator ruling on the 0.8.1 intake report, 2026-10-20; Job 3 review 2026-10-20T140908Z and the J3.T6 measurements

active.title: One shared virtualenv for the repo's verify gate
active.description: The verify: line in the repo AGENTS.md sets POETRY_VIRTUALENVS_IN_PROJECT=false with one shared poetry cache, so poetry builds a ~0.66 GB virtualenv per worktree path and nothing removes it when the tree is dropped; on 2026-10-20 70 orphaned environments (43 GB) filled the disk. Design: one shared environment that every tree's verify: reuses (for example POETRY_VIRTUALENVS_CREATE=false inside one environment kept under the shared cache), not one per path. This changes the verify: gate, so the operator rules on it with its measured cost per run against the current line (a cold and a warm run of each).
active.provenance: operator ruling on the 0.8.1 intake report, 2026-10-20; operations finding 2026-10-20 (disk full from per-worktree verify environments)
